title: Innerverse
tagline: the decentralized platform that empowers professionals and consultants through Web3
description:
Innerverse offers a comprehensive mental health ecosystem where  to real services: psychological consultations, workshops, and more community experiences. Beyond access, we bet on decentralized governance: we will evolve toward a mental health DAO, in which patients, therapists, and community members can propose improvements, vote, and co-create the platform's future.

Innerverse is a project that i started with some friends in a previous hackathon, and i wanted to keep working on it, this time i faced some tech issues related with ceramit database and cannot make the progress i expected.  I know it is not a project from scratch, but it is the project i wanted to work on.
how_its_made: Innerverse is a project that aims to be community owned and empowers data sovereignity in the mental healthcare space. Technologies like Ceramic Protocol manages identities and clinical records in a decentralized manner, (working on encrypting the data). Technologies  like Huddle (a decentralize network for video processing) enable secure real-time sessions, Hardhat is used for the smart contract development of NFT related features and DAO contrats for Innerverse governance. tools like Thirdweb abstracts the complexity of on-chain interactions. The differential value is to: transform decentralized technologies into a practical facilitator of psychological wellness, with open governance and global scalability.
